exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Television programmes Where do you usually watch TV programmes/shows? [Why?/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Television programmes What's your favourite TV programme/show? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Television programmes Are there any programmes/shows you don't like watching? [Why?/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Television programmes Do you think you will watch more TV or fewer TV programmes/shows in the future? [Why?/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe someone you know who has started a business. You should say: who this person is what work this person does why this person decided to start a business and explain whether you would like to do the same kind of work as this person.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Choosing work What kinds of jobs do young people not want to do in your country?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Choosing work Who is best at advising young people about choosing a job: teachers or parents?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Choosing work Is money always the most important thing when choosing a job?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Work-Life balance Do you agree that many people nowadays are under pressure to work longer hours and take less holiday?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Work-Life balance What is the impact on society of people having a poor work-life balance?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Work-Life balance Could you recommend some effective strategies for governments and employers to ensure people have a good work-life balance?
